description: This file defines a serializer for LoanProductBusinessEvent objects, converting them into an Avro data transfer object (LoanProductDataV1) suitable for serialization. It includes dependencies on services for retrieving loan product data, mapping data to Avro schemas, and handling custom external event data serializers.

classes.name: LoanProductBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class to convert LoanProductBusinessEvent instances into Avro-compatible data transfer objects, integrating loan product data retrieval, schema mapping, and custom data serialization.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the given business event is of type LoanProductBusinessEvent and thus serializable by this serializer.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a BusinessEvent into its corresponding Avro DTO (LoanProductDataV1), fetching data via the service and mapping it to the Avro schema, including custom data.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the class type of the schema supported by this serializer (LoanProductDataV1).

methods.name: getExternalEventCustomDataSerializers
methods.description: Provides the list of custom data serializers for external events associated with LoanProductBusinessEvent.
